'''greatrambino1981 Light Side Smugglin' Jedis''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[greatrambino1981]]
* '''Published:''' 26 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room|Cor-L-nabootheedpalacethroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Naboo Theed Palace Throne Room grea.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Kind of a pile. I do have a stategy, just not a strong one. Need playtesting in Northern Minnesota. Anybody?

== Strategy ==

Start with Kashyyyk or Corellia. Make Kessel runs from as far away as possible. If this fails or even if not drop Jedis on Naboo to make some nice drains. Space shouldn't be too much of a problem unless facing a swarm of TIEs. A better pilot Luke would be nice as well as more sabers.
